disclaimer: Synthetic generator behavior only. These figures are not real-world camera detection accuracy and carry no physical-device evidence.

dev.purpose: Rule development; tuned on these sessions.

test.purpose: Locked seeds, same generator; run after preregistration.

shift.purpose: Held-out generator variant (bitrate, GOP, jitter, loss, confounder behavior); never used for tuning.

interpretation: Abstentions count as non-candidate in the binary matrix and are reported as an abstention rate. live_stream_upload is labeled non-camera and is camera-like by construction; it is an expected false positive. Trials from one generator are correlated; no confidence interval is claimed. Synthetic generator behavior only. These figures are not real-world camera detection accuracy and carry no physical-device evidence.

visibility_ablation.description: Locked test sessions with receive frames removed and direction set to unknown, as in a transmit-only capture. rules-0.2 must abstain instead of scoring.
